page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg8i.6xlarge is a high-clock-speed compute instance built on the KVM hypervisor and the x86_64 instruction set architecture. It is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 6462C processor operating at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz, providing 24 dedicated virtual CPUs. System memory is configured at 96.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per virtual core.

Network performance on this instance features a baseline bandwidth of 18 Gbps. In terms of storage and acceleration, the instance includes no local storage volumes and no hardware GPUs, necessitating the use of remote network-attached block storage for persistence. In addition, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

From an infrastructure and cost efficiency perspective, the high clock speed architecture delivers consistent single-thread and multi-thread computational power per core. With dedicated resource allocation and no integrated local disk overhead, capacity can be sized specifically around CPU throughput and memory capacity. The instance is suited for compute-intensive tasks, relational databases, backend application serving, continuous integration builds, and data transformation jobs requiring sustained CPU frequency without dedicated GPU hardware.
